A shopper capability lives at most SHOPPER_MAX_AGE (24 h, src/identity/sessionCapability.ts:14) and the shopper object admits only the exact grants already in its stored authority (src/durable-objects/ShopperReflex.ts:1769-1770), with a new grant adoptable only when no authority exists; measured on both hosts, every request at T0+7d with a fresh or refreshed capability for the same subject answers 401 "Shopper session unavailable", and the only path that adds a grant to an existing authority is the recognized identity transfer (:2449). The host leg therefore drives the reachable return (past VISIT_GAP_MS, inside the grant's life) and applies the 7- and 14-day horizon to the memory the host actually publishes (the hydrate's config.tauMs, cross-checked against the affinity the host itself answered with).
